description: A theory is syntactically consistent if and only if all its finite subsets are syntactically consistent.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.consistent_iff_finite.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  {T : Set (L.Formula α)} :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent T ↔
    ∀ (Γ : Finset (L.Formula α)), ↑Γ ⊆ T → Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Consistent ↑Γ
